payg.why: List-price pay-as-you-go baseline. Actual commercial pricing can differ.

pack.why: Capacity comes in monthly tenant packs. A pack price was not supplied in this dataset, so the planner shows capacity and a PAYG-equivalent value, not a pack quote.

p3.why: Discount applies to the whole selected commitment, not marginal slices. Unused committed capacity is still paid for; excess usage is modeled at PAYG.

standard.why: Standard harness events have different published rates. Preset totals below are illustrative workload assumptions, not a published price per run.

reasoning.why: Reasoning tokens add a premium. Presets include an illustrative total; without a token measurement this is not an extra fixed charge per run.

voiceStandard.unit: credits per minute: classic / generative / premium
voiceStandard.why: These are today's published voice tiers. The likely scenario uses generative voice; low and high use classic and premium.

github.name: Microsoft Copilot harness
github.why: Billed on tokens, tools and the harness itself, and charges start while you build and test. Microsoft publishes light / medium / heavy planning bands instead of a fixed rate because effort varies by task. This range is an illustrative planning band, not a Microsoft rate. Replace it with your pilot measurement.

voiceNew.why: Early signals point lower than today's premium voice, but rates aren't settled. The range spans today's published tiers until they are.

reasoningWidening.unit: divide low / multiply high; likely unchanged
reasoningWidening.why: A Microsoft Research study found the cheaper-listed reasoning model cost more in 21.8% of comparisons (up to 28×), and thinking tokens on the same query varied up to 9.7× run to run. That's why reasoning-heavy work gets wider bands. The widening factor is an illustrative planning choice, not a study-derived rate.

aiBuilder.why: After Nov 1, 2026, new premium licenses no longer include seeded AI Builder credits. Existing credits are honored to end of term, and add-ons reach end of life. Usage draws AI Builder credits first, then Copilot Credits, and is otherwise blocked. Usage tracking can lag 5 or more days.

sizes.name: S
sizes.controls: Pilot with a named owner, a budget alert, and a monthly usage review.

sizes.name: M
sizes.controls: Add environment budgets, connector policies, and weekly usage reviews.

sizes.name: L
sizes.controls: Add approval gates, workload quotas, and daily anomaly reviews.

sizes.name: XL
sizes.controls: Use staged rollout, tenant-level capacity ownership, and an incident stop switch.

planning.unit: illustrative planner defaults and decision thresholds
planning.why: These size cutoffs, governance suggestions, and value thresholds are this planner's heuristics, not Microsoft licensing rules. P3 is modeled over an illustrative annual commitment horizon with level monthly use; confirm actual term and eligibility before buying. User-entered workload and value assumptions are not independently verified.

harnesses.name: Standard
harnesses.why: Use for rule-based, predictable tasks. This is the baseline against which illustrative factors are compared.

harnesses.name: Microsoft Copilot harness
harnesses.why: Use for complex multi-step reasoning. The factor is a planning band, not a fixed published rate.

harnesses.name: Customer Conversation
harnesses.why: Use for voice/chat with human escalation. Non-voice estimates provisionally use the standard baseline; voice uses the newer-harness range. Measure your actual workload.

presets.name: Sales assist agent
presets.why: Illustrative mix of answers, grounding, and actions. Replace with your own measured total.

presets.name: Daily briefing
presets.why: Illustrative briefing workload, not a published per-briefing rate.

presets.name: Customer care
presets.why: Illustrative chat workload including answers and actions; escalation time is not priced here.

presets.name: Voice agent (per minute)
presets.why: Each run represents one voice minute. The initial band follows published voice tiers; newer harness rates remain unsettled.

presets.name: Reasoning analyst
presets.unit: credits per run before harness and widening
presets.why: Illustrative total including reasoning effort, not a published analyst price. Both harness effort and reasoning variability widen the band.

presets.name: Document flows / AI Builder
presets.why: Illustrative Copilot Credit equivalent, not a conversion from seeded AI Builder credits. Validate model-specific charges and remaining entitlement.

presets.name: Small business app
presets.why: Illustrative lightweight answer/action workload; actual event mix determines consumption.
